~1. add `z--1` back (you can see the visual differences in /modules page, etc.)~
  update: i know what's the problem, the transition should be on top of the UI but the final icon should not, so applying z--1 here will be wrong. let's leave this first, i'll fix it on further PRs
2. `left-0 top-0 h-full w-full` --> `inset-0`
3. `pointer-events-none` inherits, so just adding for the parent div will be ok, no need to add them for all children

this is too lengthy (and you'll need to repeat the values every time), consider using `xor`?
e.g.
```js
return (isAnimating.value ^ props.isReverse) ? 'text-white' : props.textColor
```

additionally, you might consider using this way:
```js
const from = { position: ..., opacity: ..., ... }
const to = { ... }

const cssProps = computed(() => (isAnimating.value ^ props.isReverse) ? from : to)
```
to further reduce repeated calculations
Try not to use Chinese as comments as much as possible.
or move t inside the component props
use `disableIconAnimation` to align with the existing code logic, otherwise you'll see on the appearance page that the icon behaviors are flipped

cannot directly do this (i.e. disable the whole icon component when disabling the setting),
otherwise you'll realize that when disabling icon transitions, the lower-right icon just simply disappeared
